title_en: Taiwan warns Canada’s Carney that deeper ties with China come with risks
title_zh: 台湾警告加拿大卡尼，加深与中国大陆的关系是有风险的

paragraphs.en: HALIFAX, Nova Scotia -- Taiwan’s deputy foreign minister warned on Saturday that Prime Minister Mark Carney risks exposing Canada to the very economic coercion he has cautioned against by deepening trade ties with China, saying that Taiwan has learned the hard way that dependence on Beijing comes with consequences.
paragraphs.zh: 新斯科舍省哈利法克斯——台湾外交部次长周六警告说，总理马克·卡尼（Mark Carney）若深化与中国的贸易关系，可能使加拿大面临他本人曾警示过的经济胁迫风险；并称台湾已经吃过苦头，深知依赖北京会带来后果。

paragraphs.en: Carney has warned that major powers are using economic integration as a weapon, citing U.S. tariffs and China’s restrictions on critical minerals. He has urged middle powers to diversify their trade relationships to avoid economic coercion.
paragraphs.zh: 卡尼曾警告说，大国正将经济一体化用作武器，并以美国关税和中国对关键矿产的限制为例。他敦促中等强国实现贸易关系多元化，以避免经济胁迫。

paragraphs.en: “You have your own history. You have two Michaels,” Chen said, referring to former Canadian diplomat Michael Kovrig and businessman Michael Spavor, whose ne arly three-year detention in China prompted accusations of hostage diplomacy.
paragraphs.zh: “你们有自己的历史。你们有两个迈克尔，”陈说。他指的是前加拿大外交官迈克尔·康明凯（Michael Kovrig）和商人迈克尔·斯帕弗（Michael Spavor），两人在中国被关押近三年，引发外界对“人质外交”的指控。

paragraphs.en: The two were arrested in 2018 shortly after Canada detained Huawei executive Meng Wanzhou on a U.S. extradition request. They were released in September 2021, the same day Meng returned to China. Beijing denied their detention was politically motivated.
paragraphs.zh: 两人于2018年被捕，此前不久，加拿大应美国引渡请求拘留了华为高管孟晚舟。他们于2021年9月获释，同一天孟晚舟返回中国。北京否认拘留他们是出于政治动机。

paragraphs.en: Chen’s warning came days after Carney met with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Shenzhen and agreed to additional tariff reductions as Canada seeks to diversify trade during U.S. President Donald Trump’s trade war.
paragraphs.zh: 陈发出警告的几天前，卡尼在深圳与中国国家主席习近平会面，并同意进一步削减关税。在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发动贸易战之际，加拿大正寻求实现贸易多元化。

paragraphs.en: Carney said that Canada could turn to Chinese automakers if negotiations with Washington fail to preserve a viable Canadian auto industry. Trump has threatened 50% tariffs on Canadian vehicles and auto parts beginning on Jan. 1.
paragraphs.zh: 卡尼表示，如果与华盛顿的谈判未能保住加拿大汽车产业的生存能力，加拿大可能会转向中国汽车制造商。特朗普威胁从1月1日起对加拿大汽车和汽车零部件征收50%的关税。

paragraphs.en: Carney has argued that Canada’s trade relationship with China differs from Washington’s more complicated ties with Beijing. Canada primarily exports agricultural products, energy and other commodities rather than sensitive technologies such as advanced semiconductors.
paragraphs.zh: 卡尼主张，加拿大与中国的贸易关系不同于华盛顿与北京更为复杂的关系。加拿大主要出口农产品、能源和其他大宗商品，而不是先进半导体等敏感技术。

paragraphs.en: Taiwan reduced the share of its outbound investment going to China from more than 80% in 2010 to 3.8% last year, Chen said. Its exports to China and Hong Kong fell from nearly 44% of total exports in 2020 to about 27% last year, according to Taiwanese government figures.
paragraphs.zh: 陈说，台湾对大陆的投资占其对外投资的比例已从2010年的超过80%降至去年的3.8%。根据台湾当局的数据，台湾对大陆和香港的出口占总出口的比例从2020年的近44%降至去年的约27%。
